adaptation.trainable: 6 BN1d affine + head.0.norm1/norm2 + head.1.norm1/norm2 + final_norm affine only
adaptation.bn_stats: track_running_stats=True; BN eval in support and query; running_mean/var/num_batches_tracked immutable
adaptation.dropout: unchanged: train mode during support; eval during query
adaptation.gating_rule: retain samples with 0.1 <= H/ln(102) <= 0.5; low/high relative entropy samples no backward
adaptation.gate_threshold_selection: fixed class-count normalized thresholds; no query scan

permissions.source_labels: not used for adaptation; source/valid inputs only for existing split verification

decision.primary: 9-cell mean Macro-F1 > 0.72 and paired mean delta vs tent_entropy_gate > 0
decision.report: all seed/date pairs and Macro-F1/NAR/recovery contrasts; no early stopping or tuning
decision.collapse_diagnostic: report finite logits, predicted unique classes and max predicted-class fraction; no query-based tuning
decision.selection: no tuning; terminal step800; no early stopping based on labels
decision.interpretation: only joint recipe efficacy on observed TemporalDrift; no capacity-causality or cross-algorithm universal claim

evaluation.protocol: independent unlabeled support adaptation then fixed-state query; no query statistics or gradients
evaluation.query_order: existing query index order; no shuffle
evaluation.model_mode: support dropout train with BN eval; query model eval; BN always source running statistics
evaluation.control: historical tent_entropy_gate, tent_fixedstats_ln, tent_bn, frozen, no_pseudo_fixed and bn_batchstats_no_update; no rerun
evaluation.caveat: sample-level gate with relative thresholds H/ln(102) in [0.1,0.5]; numeric thresholds 0.462497281/2.312486407 nats frozen before formal run

development_exposure.basis: class-count normalization motivated by previous absolute gate support entropy scale; relative fractions fixed before formal run
development_exposure.dataset: observed TemporalDrift day14/day90/day270; query labels not used for threshold selection

repair_reason: Historical reference registry contains 6 conditions (54 rows), but v1 budget declared 45; no new adaptation task ran in v1.
